title: Analyst Group Memorandum — Window over which Study Hours are Gathered for the Overage Charge, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Window over which Study Hours are Gathered

Memorandum of the analyst group on which delivered studies' hours are gathered when the charge for analyst hours beyond the pool is worked out on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions. The window turns on how often the tier trues measured savings up — the true-up frequency fixed for the tier.

## Rule

- Where the tier trues measured savings up once a year, the hours are gathered by the day the owner asked for each study, over the twelve months ending on the day the charge is worked out.
- Where the tier trues measured savings up more often than once a year, the hours are gathered by the day each study was delivered, over the six months ending on that day.
- Where the tier trues no measured savings up at all, the hours are gathered by the day each study was delivered, over the twelve months ending on that day.

## Condition table

| True-up frequency fixed for the tier | Day each study is placed by | Window ending on the day of the charge |
|---|---|---|
| annual | the day the owner asked for the study | twelve months |
| semiannual or quarterly | the day the study was delivered | six months |
| none | the day the study was delivered | twelve months |

A study's record carries both the day the owner asked for it and the day it was delivered; the row above says which of the two dates places the study inside or outside the window.

## Cases (hypothetical)

*Annual true-up.* A study asked for eleven months ago and delivered ten months ago is gathered; a study asked for thirteen months ago and delivered eleven months ago is not, because at this frequency the asking day places it.

*Quarterly true-up.* A study delivered five months ago is gathered; one delivered seven months ago is not, whatever day it was asked for.

*No true-up.* A study delivered eleven months ago is gathered; one delivered thirteen months ago is not.
